result.brief: 提出“oracle 控制阶梯”量化不同控制信号（文本、首帧、深度）对视频保真度差距的闭合程度，并用项目反应模型指导预算受限的控制选择策略。
result.reason: Analyzes inference-time control signals (caption, first frame, depth) for small video generators and proposes a budgeted control-selection policy, directly serving video generation fidelity and controllability.
